messages:
Maya: Heads-up — ACME (enterprise) just pinged with a set of asks for Console observability before their pilot next month. Short thread to align on prioritization.

Omar: can you paste the asks?

Maya: sure — from customer: 1) per-route cost breakdown (token+GPU attribution), 2) span-level tracing hooks (trace id propagation across services), 3) error analytics UI with grouped root causes + sample logs, 4) sampling guide + default sampling policy.

Sam: ack. Their timelines = pilot in 4 weeks, but will accept phased delivery. Core ask = cost visibility + error grouping.

Beth: important: cost breakdown is high value but backend telemetry needs perf instrumentation. If we rush, risk adding latency.

Omar: proposal: M1 (2 wks): per-route token cost widget + lightweight samples; M2 (4 wks): tracing hooks + trace linkouts; M3 (6 wks): error analytics with grouping and sample capture.

Maya: customer said they'll take (M1 + M2) if we can guarantee <50ms added p99 per request.

Sam: can we meet 50ms? eng-runtime input?

Elaine: runtime: tracing hooks can be implemented with async sidecar instrumentation, 5-10ms overhead if we avoid sync payloads. Error sample capture needs KV cache write path — ~20ms if unbatched. Need batching and background flush.

Beth: Acceptance criteria (draft):
```
- M1: widget shows per-route token + estimated infra cost; data refresh <= 30s; unit-test for cost calc
- M2: trace hooks propagate trace id and show linkouts to trace view; end-to-end latency impact <50ms p99; canary at 10% traffic
- M3: error analytics groups by stack fingerprint; retains 100 recent samples; redact PII
```

Maya: Customer asks for canary gating and rollback policy too.

Omar: Ops question: do we need additional SLOs on trace ingestion?

Elaine: yes — add SLI for trace ingestion success 99.9% and forward/backoff policy.

Sam: tradeoff: we can push M3 post-pilot but provide a holdover: simple error rate + first-error sample.

Beth: I recommend prioritizing M1 + traces (M2) for pilot. M3 follow-up with more infra budget.

Maya: I'll send this plan back to ACME and ask for their formal acceptance. If they sign, request product sign-off by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled for 1765439999-1 at 2024-06-14T15:00Z

Omar: will create PR with feature flags and canary plan.

Sam: thx — ping me when PR is up, i'll review security/PII redaction.

Maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
